versions.subject: feat: new linux rules related to GobRAT malware (#4272)
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    Image|endswith: '/wget'
selection_output:
    - CommandLine|re: '\s-O\s' # We use regex to ensure a case sensitive argument detection
    - CommandLine|contains: '--output-document'
selection_path:
    CommandLine|contains: '/tmp/'
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: | rex field=CommandLine "(?<CommandLineMatch>\\s-O\\s)" | eval CommandLineCondition=if(isnotnull(CommandLineMatch), "true", "false") | search Image="*/wget" CommandLineCondition="true" OR CommandLine="*--output-document*" CommandLine="*/tmp/*"
